## Styling

[Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com) is set up via `tailwind.config.js` / `postcss.config.js`, with the `@tailwind` directives in `src/index.css`. `src/components/{Button,Input,Modal,Spinner}.jsx` are styled with Tailwind utility classes — every other module (`auth-react`, `router-react`, `state-zustand`, ...) only ever imports from `./components/*`, so it works unchanged no matter which styling library is picked. Restyle any of them further any time; the plain `components.css` from the base is no longer used once Tailwind is selected.
